title: Books by TED Speakers — Verified Catalogue
description:
Every book on Books Worth Reading that was written by a TED speaker, as one table: 1,278 books by 620 speakers (snapshot of 17 November 2026). Fields: title, subtitle, speaker, all authors, publication date, publisher, category, subcategory, ISBN-10, ISBN-13, language, book URL, speaker URL.

Canonical source and living version: https://www.books-worth-reading.com/dataset. Methodology: https://www.books-worth-reading.com/study/ted-speaker-books.
